page_title: MAR 2-2 STR | Marseille v Strasbourg 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+9' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
90+9' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aaron Anselmino (Strasbourg) is coming onto the pitch as Gessime Yassine cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+8' Timothy Weah (Marseille) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+7' 2 - 2 Goal! Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Geronimo Rulli.
90+6' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is going to take the penalty!

90+4' Emerson (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francois Letexier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to Strasbourg after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
90+3' Timothy Weah (Marseille) volleys the ball from just outside the box, but his effort goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Marseille.
90+1' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+1' Igor Paixao (Marseille) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Mike Penders shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Ben Chilwell will be replaced by David Datro Fofana (Strasbourg).
85' It is time for a substitution. Facundo Medina (Marseille) is on for Amine Gouiri.
83' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
80' Shots on target – 5:3.
77' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francois Letexier saw the whole situation.

76' What a big chance! Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
76' Strasbourg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

76' What a save from Geronimo Rulli! Guela Doue (Strasbourg) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out. Strasbourg earn a corner.
76' Strasbourg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
73' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
73' 2 - 1 Goal! Martial Godo plays it to Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Geronimo Rulli. 2:1.
72' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Igor Paixao (Marseille) for his blatant foul. A free kick has been awarded to Strasbourg.
71' Jacques Abardonado prepares a substitution. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang is replaced by Igor Paixao (Marseille).
71' Substitution. Bilal Nadir is replaced by Himad Abdelli (Marseille).
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.
66' Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
63' Here is a change. Lucas Hogsberg is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg).
63' Substitution. Julio Enciso walks off the pitch and Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
61' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Geronimo Rulli intercepts the ball.
60' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
58' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is penalised for a foul. Francois Letexier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
57' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' The Strasbourg players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

50' Quinten Timber (Marseille) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
49' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
47' 2 - 0 Amine Gouiri (Marseille) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Mike Penders with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
46' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Samir El Mourabet and he is replaced by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+1' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.

43' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His low effort towards the bottom right corner is stopped by Geronimo Rulli, who pulls off a glorious save!

42' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) for a foul that he committed a little earlier. Strasbourg win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

41' Ambitious effort from Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
38' Mike Penders pulls off a great save to deny Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
37' Wonderful movement by Strasbourg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
36' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
33' Marseille win a corner.
31' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
29' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) makes a strong challenge and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.

27' Lucas Hogsberg (Strasbourg) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Strasbourg are awarded a free kick.
25' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) picks up a long through ball, but Mike Penders deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

23' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a throw-in.
21' Strasbourg are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
18' Great teamplay by Marseille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' 1 - 0 GOAL - 1:0! Amine Gouiri found Mason Greenwood (Marseille) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Mike Penders off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
13' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
11' Emerson (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Penders, who smothers the ball.
9' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
8' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Strasbourg.

5' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Geronimo Rulli shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
3' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier will supervise the game today.
